senses.gloss:
दुह (औ) दुहौ r. 2nd cl. (दोग्धि, दुग्धे) 3rd pers. plu. (दुहन्ति) To milk, (इर)
दुहिर r. 1st cl. (दोहति)
 1. To hurt, to afflict, to give pain.
 2. To
kill. अदा० उभ० द्विक० अनिट् । भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।

दुह m. (धुक्) A milker.
 E. दुह्, and क्विप् aff.

दुहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
 1. Relinquishing, parting with.
 2. Milking. E.
दुह to milk, शतृ aff.

दुहितुःपति m. (-तिः) A son-in-law, a daughter's husband.
 E. दुहितृ a
daughter, in the possessive case, and पति a husband.

दुहितृ(-ता) A daughter.
 E. दुह् to milk, (the mother,) Uṇādi affix तृच्,
and इट् inserted.
